annotations.title: 中国香港特别行政区 Working Day

description:
Use this when you need a deterministic 中国香港特别行政区 Hong Kong general holidays under the General Holidays Ordinance; government/general public calendar only result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when this package is the Hong Kong general/public-holiday calendar. Statutory employee holidays, employer rest days, school calendars, bank/exchange closures and private-sector arrangements are not inferred.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2027 authority events.
Example user requests: 中国香港特别行政区: 2027 Lunar New Year substitute. | 中国香港特别行政区: 2026 Ching Ming substitution.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2027-02-09"} | {"date":"2026-04-06"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Sunday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/hong-kong-general-holidays-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/hong-kong-general-holidays-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in the pinned Hong Kong Government 2026-2027 general-holiday coverage.

name: check_hk_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Hong Kong general holidays under the General Holidays Ordinance; government/general public calendar only

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.
